Game Overview

In FlowTint, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in FlowTint, a vibrant puzzle game combining color and chemistry. Strategize every move wisely, using only 22 attempts to flood the grid with color, each representing a chemical element. Sharpen your logic while learning in this engaging challenge that blends strategy and education seamlessly.
